name: typewriter
title: Typewriter: the line being typed held at the optical line, and the other paragraphs dimmed while typing
description: Design 5.5, 7.7 and 7.14. With Focus while writing set to Typewriter, a note of two paragraphs is written, which brings focus at once (text that came without a key). A new paragraph is typed: the page scrolls at once by a line and the text is eased up from where it was drawn on the snap spring (380 ms), the line being typed staying 38% down the window; the other paragraphs dim to 40% (200 ms, standard) and, 1.5 s after the last key, come back to full (400 ms, standard). Then ↑: the paragraph above becomes the current one and comes to the optical line. Then twelve lines arriving at once: the page moves by all of them at once and the text is eased up by three lines at most (7.14). Then a line and Esc straight after it: the page is emptied, the eased movement stops, and the blank page's placeholder fades in where it is rather than sliding (7.14).
